messages.subject: Project Polaris - SPA revised draft (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Following our call, our revised draft attached. We've moved the cap to 22.5%, the escrow release to 15 months, and adjusted the lower earn-out threshold to £4.4m. We think this is a fair landing zone on the limitations. Subject to the open DD items (Leeds licence, Pennine consent) we should be able to agree the form quickly.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Sarah,

Thank you - the clients are broadly content. We'll revert with any final turns this week. On the limitations we ultimately settled at the original 25% cap / £350k basket / 7-year tax in exchange for a tightening elsewhere, as discussed - I'll confirm in the next turn so we're aligned for the engrossment.

Regards,
Jonathan Vane
